target_customer: Ecommerce and direct to consumer consumer brands that source physical products from overseas factories
problem: Small consumer brands had no easy way to book third party quality inspections, run supplier audits and track compliance testing across countries.
business_model: B2B SaaS plus per inspection marketplace fees on a network of inspection partners
product_category: Quality control and compliance management platform

founders.name: Prince Ghosh
previous_startups: Workbench Technologies (supply chain software for ecommerce)
founders.background_notes: FreightWaves says Ghosh and a co-founder previously founded Workbench Technologies.

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow software plus scheduling of inspectors, which is standard web engineering. The hard part was building a global inspector network.

defensibility.rationale: Inspector network and stored audit records create mild lock in, but incumbents in sourcing and inspection services offer similar services.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying it. A PitchBook profile reports an acquisition by Pietra in March 2025, unverified.

market_need_then: Direct to consumer brands outsourced manufacturing to Asia and needed pre shipment inspections; the 2020 customer list (Brooklinen, Honest Company, Dr. Squatch) shows paying demand among DTC brands.

identity.logo: Light logo with an FQ monogram, per the site text
identity.visual_style: Plain and light, consumer brand logos as social proof
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, reassuring, benefit focused, for example Quality control made simple

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name and little press on the brand itself; recognition limited to DTC operations circles.

outcome_analysis: Factored Quality sold quality control and compliance tooling to over 100 direct to consumer brands and raised a reported 5.6 million dollar seed in early 2022 after YC, with founders who had earlier built supply chain software. The YC directory marks it as acquired, and a PitchBook profile names Pietra with a March 2025 date, which could not be cross checked. The price and the reasons for the sale are not public.
notes: Seed of 5.6M is reported by FreightWaves and consistent with a CB Insights listing dated 2022-02-15; CB Insights total of 5.75M over 3 rounds and VCBacked 1.5M total conflict and are unverified. Acquirer Pietra and date March 2025 appear only in a PitchBook snippet, so they are not recorded in exit. Competitor searches returned only Inspectorio material with no dated link to the 2020 batch, so the list is empty. Branding search found nothing on name origin.
